name: Danny Dwyer
introCopy:
Hello, I am Danny Dwyer, sometimes referred to as Dwyski. I have directed, shot, and cut for a solid 15 years. I was born and raised in Ohio, and have carried the Midwest work ethic with me on every project: show respect and understanding for everyone on set, be the first to show up, and the last to leave.

14 years in New York City taught me a bit of everything directing, lighting, shooting, and editing. I then spent a decade in Los Angeles, where it all came together.

My camera has been pointed at A-list celebrities, dudes serving life sentences, pop icons, and people like you and me. It’s been on the Olympic podium too, rolling the moment gold, silver, and bronze went around the necks of the best athletes in the world. The lens doesn’t care who’s famous. It cares what’s true, beautifully lit, and with the intention to always serve the story. That’s what I chase. 

Along the way my work made its way to several premieres from Cannes to Cleveland; campaigns for Google, PUMA, Columbia, ELLE, and Harper's Bazaar. I have worked with everyone from Lady Gaga to Beck, from Post Malone to the neighborhood postman. 

Got a story worth telling? I want to hear it.
